svg.text: 256×256 2D Dungeon Isomorphism (16 Sectors × 8 Gadgets) & Abramsky–Hyland–Ong Game Semantics
A. 256×256 2D Board (4×4 Boustrophedon Grid of 64×64 Sectors)
14,881 Walkable Tiles | 128 Unique Gadget Coords (x_k, y_k) ∈ [0..255]²
Fog-of-War Rule: Room k is observable ONLY when Avatar reaches (x_k, y_k)!
Blind Run halts at S₀ Safe K₀ (10,12) → masks faults at S₃, S₇, S₁₁, S₁₅!
2D Drone Waypoint Bisection solves all 5 masked faults in 38 probes!
B. Zoomed 64×64 Sector S_i Architecture (Bijection Φ_iso to 8 SSH Stages)
1. Arena G = (M_P, M_O, λ, ⊢) & Sequential Composition G₁ ; G₂ ; ... ; G_D:
• Player (P = Diagnostic Agent) plays Question moves q_a ∈ A_epistemic ∪ A_ontic.
• Opponent (O = Network/Dungeon Environment) replies with Answer moves o ∈ O_a.
2. Views ⌜s⌝, Innocence, and Observational Aliasing as Partial Visibility:
• In Hyland–Ong Game Semantics, an Innocent Strategy σ depends ONLY on Player's
P-view ⌜s⌝. Under end-to-end play a_e2e, O hides internal moves m_0..m_{k*}
and emits only terminal move o = Φ_e2e(k*), collapsing 48 plays into 1 P-view!
3. Prefix Probes Π_m as Interaction-Revealing Subgame Projections:
• Prefix probe Π_m forces Opponent to reveal the boolean Answer of subgame G_{0..m}.
• Full Abstraction & Bisimulation Theorem: The 256×256 2D Dungeon Arena G_2D and
the 16-Hop SSH Arena G_SSH have isomorphic legal play trees L(G_2D) ≅ L(G_SSH)!
